Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Do not perform the task.", "input": "can you make a little shelf note for our board-game lending shelf at the community center? the inventory we'll give you has each game's title, whether it's cooperative, its player count, and if it's available right now. only if there are at least three games that are both cooperative and available and can be played by exactly four people, write a note of about 60 words that recommends exactly two of those games. please base the recommendations on that inventory, not games that aren't listed. if there aren't three that meet all of those conditions, don't write recommendations; make a short reminder instead for someone to check and update the inventory before recommendations are made. the reminder is the other option, not an extra note to go with recommendations. output just the shelf note or just the reminder, whichever applies, with no explanation before or after.", "output": "Using the supplied board-game lending shelf inventory, which lists each game's title, whether it is cooperative, its player count, and whether it is currently available, follow this condition:

- If at least three listed games are both cooperative and currently available, and can be played by exactly four people, write a shelf note of about 60 words recommending exactly two qualifying games. Base the recommendations only on games in the inventory.
- Otherwise, write a short reminder for someone to check and update the inventory before recommendations are made.

Output only the applicable shelf note or reminder, with no explanation."}]
